$comment: Controls how hard the app pushes an update. Edited by hand and read by the
release workflow, so forcing an update is a deliberate act rather than a
side effect of shipping a build.
minimumBuild: clients on a lower versionCode are blocked with a mandatory
prompt they cannot dismiss. Raise it only for a breaking API change or a bad
bug, because it locks people out of the app until they install.
